card.name: Drug interaction section wording
card.fires_on: Words inside drug-interaction text, such as 'interaction' after 'this' or 'pharmacodynamic', 'use' after 'concomitant', and 'may' after 'concurrent use'. It also fires on commas in lists of effects and on pieces of words like 'contraindicated'.
